235300723_397e70ff.text: Immature neurons in the PCX layer II can be classified into different subtypes depending on their morphology, physiological properties and degree of maturation (Gómez-Climent et al., 2008), namely: (1) tangled cells, which are very small and have very short and intricate processes; (2) complex cells, which are more mature and display axon initial segments (AIS) and typical apical dendrites in layer I [15].

235300723_3f3c223e.text: the presence of AIS on mature, complex cells of the PCX layer II provided the capacity of repetitive action potential firing that was absent in less mature precursors devoid of AIS

235300723_212b74f5.text: The number of GFP+ cells coexpressing markers of immature neurons decreased dramatically when the animals were sacrificed 6 months after tamoxifen administration (3m-t→9) (PSA-NCAM+ 4.7 ± 1.7%, P < 0.0001***; DCX+ 6.0 ± 1.4%, P < 0.0001***; DCX+/PSA-NCAM+ 3.25 ± 1%, P < 0.0001***)
